{{Quote|Meanwhile, the Mandalorians were rapidly building warships at Breshig and Arda, utilizing vast caches of war matériel stolen during the Sith Wars from Foerost and Abhean.|Vilnau Tept, 412th Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History|<ref name="EGTW" />}}
'''Abhean''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Maldrood sector/Legends|Maldrood sector]], on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. It was the farthest major world of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Tionese War]]. At some point after the conflict began in [[24,000 BBY]], the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]] [[Battle of Abhean|conquered]] Abhean. The planet saw fighting again in [[15,480 BBY]], when the [[Strontium Raid]] was carried out as part of the [[Second Alsakan Conflict]]. Around [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], Abhean became a major hub of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].

Large amounts of war matériel were [[Thief/Legends|stolen]] from Abhean by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] of [[3996 BBY]], and the planet fell within the borders of [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]] [[3956 BBY|thirty years]] later. By [[990 BBY]], the large [[Starship/Legends|starship]] construction [[Shipyard/Legends|facility]] known as the [[Abhean Shipyards]] was located in the planet's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], and the massive [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] [[Praxeum ship/Legends|praxeum ship]] ''[[Chu'unthor]]'' was built there in [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]].

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a creature known as [[Taozin/Legends|taozin]] was supposedly discovered in a shipyard at Abhean, which piqued the interest of a [[Unidentified Jedi (G9 Rigger-class light freighter)|former Jedi]] intending to use the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-masking properties of the taozin's scales for protection. Abhean's shipyards were exploited by the [[Greater Maldrood]] dominion of the Imperial [[High Admiral]] [[Treuten Teradoc]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], after which the planet became a part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Abhean system/Legends|Abhean system]] was [[Battle of the Abhean system|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]].

==Description==
Abhean was a terrestrial<ref name="SWTOR" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|6|Abhean}}</ref> located in the [[Abhean system/Legends|Abhean system]], a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Maldrood sector/Legends|Maldrood sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]],<ref name="TEA" /> which connected it to the [[Besh Gorgon system/Legends|Besh Gorgon system]] and the [[Eucer sector/Legends|Eucer sector's]] [[Euceron system/Legends|Euceron system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and which served as a dividing line between the regions known as the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
===Ancient Republic===
{{Quote|They wanted me to go to Coruscant, to tell my story. But I refused. Instead I went to Abhean to enlist, and eventually they let me.|Baragwin sense lattice imprinted by a Republic soldier|<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref>}}
[[File:Strontium_Raid.jpg|thumb|left|220px|In 15,480 BBY, Abhean was the site of the Strontium Raid.]]
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Tionese War]], Abhean was the farthest major world of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the early stages of that<ref name="EGTW" /> [[Standard century/Legends|century]]-long conflict,<ref name="TEA" /> which was fought between the Republic and the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]]<ref name="EGTW" /> beginning in [[24,000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] raiders [[Battle of Abhean|conquered]] Abhean.<ref name="EGTW" /> Mere [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the war's end, a group of Tionese [[Tionjack|warships]] [[Attack on Okator VIII|destroyed]] several Republic settlements on the celestial body [[Okator VIII]]. A local [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Falang Minor)|farm-boy]] who survived the attack and the destruction of their family's [[Unidentified farm (Okator VIII)|farm]] later left Okator VIII. Despite being encouraged to tell about the attack on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of the Republic,<ref name="TEA" /> they instead traveled to Abhean in order to enlist in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. Although the boy did eventually become a [[Republic soldier]], the war ended before they could avenge their loss in combat against the Tionese.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

Abhean became a battleground again in [[15,480 BBY]]; that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Strontium Raid]] of the [[Second Alsakan Conflict]]&mdash;one of a [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|series]] of wars pitting the Republic worlds Coruscant and [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] and their respective allies against each other in a battle for dominance&mdash;was carried out at Abhean, which remained loyal to Coruscant at that time. Abhean became a major [[Navy/Legends|naval]] hub of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] when the centralized [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], which had largely been disbanded in the aftermath of the Tionese War, was re-established around [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

===Sith Wars===
During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] of [[3996 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] passed through the Abhean [[Star system/Legends|system]] as part of a [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] advance along the Perlemian Trade Route.<ref name="TEA" /> As noted by [[Vilnau Teupt]] in the keynote address "[[Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul]]" at [[Brentaal Academy]]'s [[Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History|412th Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History]] in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], during that conflict the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] [[Thief/Legends|stole]] large amounts of war matériel from both Abhean and the fellow [[Foerost Shipyards|Republic shipyards]] at [[Foerost/Legends|Foerost]]. Teupt also noted that the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] used the captured technologies and supplies for the construction of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] during the build-up for the [[Mandalorian Wars]] of [[3976 BBY]]&ndash;[[3960 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Between [[3959 BBY]] and [[3956 BBY]], Abhean was situated in the territory of [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
At some point around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Never Printed, Never Broadcast" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> new evidence surfaced suggesting that the renowned war [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Choel Nyl]], who was presumed to have [[Death/Legends|died]] at some point, was in fact alive and in hiding. An individual affiliated with one of the parties in the [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] ongoing at the time sent a companion to find Nyl. The companion discovered that the journalist was living under an assumed name on Abhean. In return for his privacy, Nyl shared his notes and eventually revealed a secret that had driven him into retirement.<ref name="SWTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

===Rise of the Empire===
[[Jedi ace]] [[Crix Sunburris]] noted in the [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'',<ref name="JP" /> published at some point by [[990 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2010/12/endnotes-for-star-wars-jedi-path-part-1.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Jedi Path (part 1 of 4)|quote=Okay, so we've established that this particular copy of the [[Book/Legends|book]] dates from [[115 BBY]]. But the content inside is [...] dating from the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[990 BBY]].}}</ref> that they were advancing a proposal to construct a massive new [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Praxeum ship/Legends|praxeum ship]], named the ''[[Sunburris]]'', at the [[Abhean Shipyards]]<ref name="JP" /> in Abhean's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].<ref name="POTJ" /> Sunburris' vision eventually saw fruition<ref name="JP" /> in [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]], when [[Republic Fleet Systems]] constructed the Jedi academy [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Chu'unthor]]'' in Abhean's orbit.<ref name="FF95">{{FactFile|95|CHU 1-2|''Chu'unthor''}}</ref>

During the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Abhean lay within [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. At that time, the [[Twelfth Army/Legends|Twelfth Sector Army]] of the Republic was charged with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the Confederacy in Abhean's vicinity. The planet fell within the borders of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

===Imperial shipyards===
{{Quote|One of my contacts found a taozin in a shipyard maintenance shaft, feeding on borcatu.|From the captain's log of a modified G9 ''Rigger''-class light freighter|<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>}}
[[File:GreaterMaldrood7to8ABY-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The shipyards at Abhean were utilized by the Greater Maldrood dominion of High Admiral Treuten Teradoc.]]
According to a [[Captain/Legends|captain's]] log later discovered in a modified [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|G9 ''Rigger''-class light freighter]],<ref name="FDCR" /> in 17 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="17 BBY">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]] dates the supposed discovery of a [[Taozin/Legends|taozin]] at Abhean to the [[Great ReSynchronization]] date 18:5:25, which corresponds to [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> by the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 18:5:25, a creature known as [[Taozin/Legends|taozin]] was discovered inhabiting a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] maintenance shaft at Abhean. According to the log, the individual who discovered the creature notified a contact, a [[Unidentified Jedi (G9 Rigger-class light freighter)|former Jedi]] who was the captain of the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]]. The latter supposedly took a great interest in the discovery due to the fact that a taozin's scales made their wielder invisible in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], which the captain thought could offer protection from the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitors]], the Empire's [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi hunters]].<ref name="FDCR" />

In order to establish the self-sufficiency of his [[Greater Maldrood]] dominion established during the Empire's fragmentation in the wake of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> Imperial [[High Admiral]]<ref name="EGTW" /> [[Treuten Teradoc]] took control of the shipyards at Abhean as well as those in the [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot sector's]] [[Thanos system]].<ref name="TEA" /> By [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], Abhean had been incorporated into the territory of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="EGTW" /> with its population numbering between one and ten billion around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. At some point between [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the military forces of the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Battle of the Abhean system|conquered]] the Abhean system during its [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Locations==
{{Main|Abhean Shipyards}}
{{Quote|One proposal I'm personally advancing is the construction of a new, peacetime praxeum at the Abhean Shipyards.|Crix Sunburris, ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''|<ref name="JP" />}}
The Abhean Shipyards<ref name="JP" /> were a large set of starship construction facilities located in the orbit of Abhean.<ref name="POTJ" /> During the reign of the Galactic Republic, the shipyards held contracts for the construction of custom academy ships for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]],<ref name="FDCR" /> with the Abhean facilities being the only ones large enough to accommodate the construction of the massive vessel ''Chu'unthor''.<ref name="POTJ" />

After the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|supplanted]] by the Galactic Empire, the Abhean Shipyards almost exclusively built and maintained [[Imperial Supply Corps]] [[Container ship/Legends|container ships]] and became known as the creator of some of the largest [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighters]] in the galaxy.<ref name="FDCR" /> Shortly before the Battle of Endor, the shipyards at Abhean were operated by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] and produced both [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] and [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Abhean was first mentioned in the [[2002]] ''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]'', which was published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="POTJ" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed Abhean in grid square R-7.<ref name="TEA" /> Abhean was subsequently mentioned in an Investigation Crew Skill mission of the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="SWTOR" />
